title: Theo and the Vow
author: Lior Vasquez
blurb: Isandro Oyelaran, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
